meta.notes: A particle type of your own (msm:particle): a four-pointed spark that twinkles (animation loop, a frame every 2 ticks), drawn from textures/particle/drifting_ember_0.png to _3.png, which lowering also lists in the description assets/msm_examples/particles/drifting_ember.json. It lives 40 ticks, is 0.1 blocks to each side of its centre and floats up (gravity -0.1). fade out makes it see-through towards the end. emissive draws it at full brightness, so it glows in the dark. Use msm_examples:drifting_ember in a spawn_particle action, as a block's ambient particle, or with /particle msm_examples:drifting_ember ~ ~1 ~ 0.3 0.3 0.3 0 10. It needs the Fabric mod jar export, on the server and on every client.
